description: Create or update a budget configuration for an agent or the entire organization. Enforcement modes: "alert_only" (notify, never block), "soft_block" (block with override) and "hard_block" (block). "soft_block" and "hard_block" act only on LLM calls routed through the Metrx gateway (proxy); calls reported by the SDK or OpenTelemetry are never blocked. They are unavailable while the gateway's Cloudflare settings for budget sync are unset: the server then refuses them with 409 ENFORCEMENT_UNAVAILABLE and only "alert_only" works. Specify limits in dollars. Needs an API key with the 'admin' scope (an org owner or admin mints one in Settings → Security → API Keys); any other key is refused with 403 — then make the change at https://app.metrxbot.com/settings/budgets. Do NOT use just to change enforcement mode — use update_budget_mode for that. Requires an API key with the 'admin' scope.

agent_id.description: Agent to set budget for. Omit for org-wide budget.

enforcement_mode.description: How to enforce the budget when exceeded. soft_block/hard_block: gateway traffic only; 409 ENFORCEMENT_UNAVAILABLE while gateway enforcement is not configured

limit_dollars.description: Spending limit in dollars (for example 100 means 100 dollars per period)

warning_pct.description: Percentage of limit that triggers a warning (default: 80)

name: metrx_set_budget
title: Set Budget
